title: Define Radio ABC/Protocol
description: Create python/src/lichen/radio/base.py with Radio Protocol (typing.Protocol). Methods: async transmit(payload: bytes) -> bool, async receive(timeout_ms: int) -> tuple[bytes, int, int] | None (payload, rssi, snr), configure(freq_hz: int, tx_power_dbm: int) -> None. This is the interface all radio implementations must satisfy.
notes: Verified complete without edits on 2026-08-27. python/src/lichen/radio/base.py defines @runtime_checkable Radio(Protocol) with required async transmit(bytes)->bool, async receive(timeout_ms:int)->tuple[bytes,int,int]|None, and synchronous configure(freq_hz:int,tx_power_dbm:int)->None. Optional channel parameters and async cad are compatible extensions required by current SimRadio and focused mocks. Runtime checkability is exercised by isinstance tests. Contract documentation matches SimRadio semantics: transmit rejects payloads over MAX_LORA_PAYLOAD, receive returns None on timeout and SimRadio rejects invalid timeout ranges, configure is explicitly advisory/local-state only, and hardware errors are permitted to raise.
